bearded-winged-masks-with-curled-leaf-sc.description: A horizontal etched frieze between double rules. At the left end a round bearded mask with feathered wings behind it faces left; at the right end a second winged bearded mask faces right. Between them run two large curled acanthus volutes, a folded leaf cup at the centre and two trumpet-shaped bell flowers hanging on stalks, all joined by one stem. Dark brown ink line work on a transparent background.
bearded-winged-masks-with-curled-leaf-sc.quality: The rules are hand-printed and slightly uneven; short faint stretches of them were completed from neighbouring ink.
bearded-winged-masks-with-curled-leaf-sc.title: Frieze with two winged bearded masks
usage_notes: Complete band; the double rules above and below are part of the print, so crop inside them to use the masks and scroll alone.
Both ends terminate in a mask, so it does not repeat; use it once as a header or footer band.

grape-and-lobed-leaf-scroll-with-central.description: A horizontal etched frieze between double rules. A single vine stem runs the whole length and is knotted into a loop at the centre; along it hang four large lobed vine leaves, two bunches of grapes (one left of centre, one right of centre) and curling tendrils with small buds. Dark brown ink line work on a transparent background.
grape-and-lobed-leaf-scroll-with-central.quality: The rules are hand-printed and slightly uneven; short faint stretches of them were completed from neighbouring ink.
grape-and-lobed-leaf-scroll-with-central.title: Grapevine frieze with central knot
usage_notes: Complete band; the double rules above and below are part of the print, so crop inside them to use the vine alone.
The only frieze of the sheet without a creature; the plainest choice for a text divider.

horned-dragon-with-flowering-scroll.description: A horizontal etched frieze between double rules. A dragon fills the left half, facing left with open jaws, a long forked tongue, a curled horn and a small budding sprig in front of its snout; its feathered body has a raised wing and two clawed feet. Its tail flows right into a foliate scroll of acanthus volutes and leaf sprays ending in a small bud at the right end. Dark brown ink line work on a transparent background.
horned-dragon-with-flowering-scroll.quality: The rules are hand-printed and slightly uneven; short faint stretches of them were completed from neighbouring ink.
horned-dragon-with-flowering-scroll.title: Frieze of a horned dragon with a flowering tail
usage_notes: Complete band; the double rules above and below are part of the print, so crop inside them to use the dragon and scroll alone.
The dragon faces left; mirror the band for a right-facing use.

paired-bearded-heads-with-horns-and-flow.description: A horizontal etched frieze between double rules. At the centre two bearded male heads in profile sit back to back, the left one facing left and the right one facing right; each beard flows into a trumpet-shaped horn. Vine stems with trefoil leaves and clover-like leaflets curl out from the heads to a five-petalled flower at each end. Dark brown ink line work on a transparent background.
paired-bearded-heads-with-horns-and-flow.quality: The rules are hand-printed and slightly uneven; short faint stretches of them were completed from neighbouring ink.
paired-bearded-heads-with-horns-and-flow.title: Frieze with back-to-back bearded heads
usage_notes: Complete band; the double rules above and below are part of the print, so crop inside them to use the heads and scroll alone.
Symmetrical about the paired heads, so it sits well centred under a title.

paired-horned-creatures-and-twin-flower-.description: A horizontal etched frieze between double rules. Two scaly winged dragons with long curled horns and open mouths lie at the ends, the left one facing left and the right one facing right; their tails curl inward into scrolls that each hold a five-petalled flower, and a fleur-de-lis-shaped tie joins the two scrolls at the centre. Dark brown ink line work on a transparent background.
paired-horned-creatures-and-twin-flower-.quality: The rules are hand-printed and slightly uneven; short faint stretches of them were completed from neighbouring ink.
paired-horned-creatures-and-twin-flower-.title: Frieze with two horned dragons and twin flowers
usage_notes: Complete band; the double rules above and below are part of the print, so crop inside them to use the dragons and flowers alone.
Symmetrical about the central tie, so it sits well centred under a title.

paired-human-headed-birds-with-tied-scro.description: A horizontal etched frieze between double rules. Two winged creatures with curly-haired human heads, feathered bodies, clawed legs and long scaly tails lie at the ends, the left one facing left and the right one facing right. Their tails loop toward the centre, where two small crested dragon heads face a knotted tie topped by a fleur-de-lis. Dark brown ink line work on a transparent background.
paired-human-headed-birds-with-tied-scro.quality: The rules are hand-printed and slightly uneven; short faint stretches of them were completed from neighbouring ink.
paired-human-headed-birds-with-tied-scro.title: Frieze with two human-headed winged creatures
usage_notes: Complete band; the double rules above and below are part of the print, so crop inside them to use the creatures alone.
Symmetrical about the central tie, so it sits well centred under a title.

paired-winged-beasts-with-central-face.description: A horizontal etched frieze between double rules. A frontal human face with leafy hair sits at the centre between two feathered volutes. On each side a lean horned, dog-like winged beast runs outward, the left one facing left and the right one facing right with open mouth, and a small leafy sprig grows between each beast and the face. Dark brown ink line work on a transparent background.
paired-winged-beasts-with-central-face.quality: The rules are hand-printed and slightly uneven; short faint stretches of them were completed from neighbouring ink.
paired-winged-beasts-with-central-face.title: Frieze with two winged beasts and a central face
usage_notes: Complete band; the double rules above and below are part of the print, so crop inside them to use the beasts and face alone.
Symmetrical about the central face, so it sits well centred under a title.

paired-winged-putti-holding-bowl-in-scro.description: A horizontal etched frieze between double rules. Two winged putti face each other at the centre and together hold a shallow bowl from which leaves sprout; their lower bodies turn into feathered, scaly scrolls that run outward to the ends, where they finish in curled acanthus leaves, a tendril with buds at the left and a leafy terminal at the right. Dark brown ink line work on a transparent background.
paired-winged-putti-holding-bowl-in-scro.quality: The rules are hand-printed and slightly uneven; short faint stretches of them were completed from neighbouring ink.
paired-winged-putti-holding-bowl-in-scro.title: Frieze with two winged putti holding a bowl
usage_notes: Complete band; the double rules above and below are part of the print, so crop inside them to use the putti and scroll alone.
Symmetrical about the bowl, so it sits well centred under a title.

scroll-with-horned-bearded-mask.description: A horizontal etched frieze between double rules. From a lobed leaf with berried tendrils at the left, a stem curls through acanthus volutes and a looped, scalloped feathered stem into a hairy winged creature whose body fills the right half; its long-bearded head with a curled horn is at the right end, facing right with open mouth. Dark brown ink line work on a transparent background.
scroll-with-horned-bearded-mask.quality: The rules are hand-printed and slightly uneven; short faint stretches of them were completed from neighbouring ink.
scroll-with-horned-bearded-mask.title: Frieze of a scroll ending in a horned bearded head
usage_notes: Complete band; the double rules above and below are part of the print, so crop inside them to use the scroll alone.
Reads from the leaf at the left to the head at the right; mirror it for a left-pointing use.

tall-grotesque-candelabrum-with-paired-s.description: A tall, narrow, symmetrical etched candelabrum seen frontally. From the bottom up, a stepped plinth carries an acanthus base with two bearded masks, a blank tablet, two winged dolphins, a fluted basin, two standing satyrs each raising a flaming cup with a bird-headed grotesque at either side, a second basin, two crouching bat-winged grotesques, two more dolphins, a plumed stem, a small nude figure between two balusters, and a crossbar hung with swags and flaming torches. Brownish-grey ink line work on a transparent background.
tall-grotesque-candelabrum-with-paired-s.quality: A handwritten numeral 7 at the lower left and a few faint stray marks near the right edge are from the sheet and were kept; the ornament runs to within a few pixels of the left edge.
tall-grotesque-candelabrum-with-paired-s.title: Candelabra grotesque with two satyrs
usage_notes: Very tall piece (about 1 to 3.5); it suits a page margin, a column or a vertical separator at full height.
The blank tablet above the base can carry a short caption.

thistle-panel.description: An upright rectangular etched panel inside a thin black frame line. Thick, white thistle stems with spiked lobed leaves and small thistle heads curl and interlace over a dark cross-hatched ground; a bird holding a sprig flies in at the top left, a crane-like bird stands at the top right, a third bird perches at the lower left, and a few open five-petalled flowers fill the corners. The monogram DH is cut into the stem at the bottom centre. Black, grey and white; the panel is opaque with its ground kept, and only the margin outside the frame line is transparent.
thistle-panel.title: Thistle panel with birds
usage_notes: Opaque panel with its original hatched ground and frame line; place it as a picture or plate, not as a cut-out.
The DH monogram at the bottom centre is part of the print and should stay visible.

winged-putto-with-shield-and-braided-scr.description: A horizontal etched frieze between double rules. A winged putto lies at the left end facing left and holds up an empty curved-top shield; its lower body turns into two intertwined, braided stems that run to the right through a leafy calyx flower and finish at the right end in a fanned leaf terminal with a small spiral. Dark brown ink line work on a transparent background.
winged-putto-with-shield-and-braided-scr.quality: The rules are hand-printed and slightly uneven; short faint stretches of them were completed from neighbouring ink.
winged-putto-with-shield-and-braided-scr.title: Frieze of a winged putto with a shield and braided scroll
usage_notes: Complete band; the double rules above and below are part of the print, so crop inside them to use the putto and scroll alone.
The shield at the left is blank and can carry a small monogram or device.

summary: Friezes, a thistle fillet and a candelabra grotesque etched by Daniel Hopfer in Augsburg around 1515, taken from three sheets in the Metropolitan Museum of Art; loose prints by one artist, grouped by sheet.
title: Daniel Hopfer ornament prints
